59:1: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth glorifies Allah. He is al-Aziz, al-Hakim.
59:2: He is the One Who expelled those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book from their homes for the first gathering. You did not think that they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allah. But Allah came upon them from where they did not expect at all and cast terror into their hearts. They were destroying their homes with their own hands and the hands of the believers. So take heed, O possessors of insight!
59:3: And if Allah had not decreed exile for them, He would have punished them in this world; and in the Hereafter, for them is the punishment of the Fire.
59:4: This is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger; and whoever opposes Allah, surely Allah is severe in punishment.
59:5: Whatever tender palm tree you cut down or left standing upon its roots, it was by the permission of Allah and in order to disgrace the defiantly disobedient.
59:6: And for that which Allah restored to His Messenger from them, you spurred neither horse nor camel. But Allah gives His messengers power over whom He wills. Allah is capable of all things.
59:7: That which Allah restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns belongs to Allah, to the Messenger, to the relatives, the orphans, the needy, and the traveler, so that it may not become a wealth circulating among the rich among you. Whatever the Messenger gives you, take it, and whatever he forbids you from, refrain from it. And fear Allah. Surely Allah is severe in retribution.
59:8: It is for the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, who seek bounty and pleasure from Allah and help Allah and His Messenger; it is they who are the truthful.
59:9: And those who settled in the home and the faith before them love those who emigrated to them, and find no need in their breasts for what they were given, and they prefer them over themselves even if they themselves are in need; and whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul, then it is they who are the successful.
59:10: And those who came after them say: Our Rabb, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not put in our hearts any resentment toward those who believe. Our Rabb, surely You are most compassionate, most merciful.
59:11: Did you not see those who act hypocritically? They say to their brothers who disbelieved from among the People of the Book: If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will never obey anyone concerning you. And if you are fought, we will certainly help you. Allah bears witness that they are definitely liars.
59:12: By oath, if they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and by oath, if they are fought, they will not help them, and by oath, even if they help them, they will surely turn their backs and flee, then they will not be helped.
59:13: You are a more intense fear in their hearts than Allah; this is because they are a people who do not understand.
59:14: They will not fight you all together except in fortified towns or from behind walls. Their fighting among themselves is severe. You think them united, but their hearts are divided. That is because they are a people who do not reason.
59:15: Their situation is like the situation of those shortly before them: they tasted the evil consequence of their conduct, and for them is a painful punishment.
59:16: It is like the situation of Satan when he said to man, 'Disbelieve.' But when he disbelieved, he said, 'I am free from you; surely I fear Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.'
59:17: The outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrongdoers.
59:18: O you who believe, fear Allah. Let every soul look to what it has put forward for tomorrow. Fear Allah. Surely Allah is fully aware of whatever you do.
59:19: And do not be like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget their own souls; it is they who are the defiantly disobedient.
59:20: The companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise are not equal. The companions of Paradise, they are the triumphant.
59:21: If We had sent down this Quran upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and torn apart from the fear of Allah. And these parables We present to people so that they may reflect.
59:22: He is Allah; there is no deity except Him. He is the Knower of the unseen and the seen. He is ar-Rahman, ar-Rahim.
59:23: He is Allah; there is no deity except Him; He is al-Malik, al-Quddus, as-Salam, al-Mu'min, al-Muhaymin, al-Aziz, al-Jabbar, al-Mutakabbir. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
59:24: He is Allah; the Creator, the Originator, the Fashioner. To Him belong the most beautiful names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him. He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
